MeshOptimiser v0.13.0

The current code as a zip, straight from GitHub. Free, open source, MIT licence. Windows and macOS.

Download .zip View on GitHub What is new in v0.13.0

Get started

Unzip, start, drop a file.

  1. 01

    Download and unzip

    Unpack the folder anywhere. There is no installer: everything, its Python environment included, lives in that folder.

  2. 02

    Start it

    The first run sets up its Python environment, pulls the dependencies and opens the viewer; after that it starts in about a second.

  3. 03

    Drop a file

    Drop a .step or .stp file on the welcome screen, or run the converter from the command line.

Windows
start.bat
macOS
./start.command
Command line
python step2glb.py input.step --meshopt

Requirements

What it needs.

Troubleshooting
Python
3.10, 3.11 or 3.12. 3.13 is not supported yet by cadquery-ocp.
Browser
One with WebGPU: a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
Disk
About 2 GB free for the Python environment on the first install.
Network
None to run. The viewer’s libraries are bundled; only a few rarely used converters are fetched on demand.
